text_block_list.text:
The one who came out on top in the dead 
heat at the Shuka Sho was Daiwa Scarlet, 
who displayed growth even greater than 
Vodka's.

After the race, Daiwa Scarlet snaps at 
Vodka, declaring that she will win at the 
Arima Kinen, too.

Then, she tells Vodka that she will run in 
the Queen Elizabeth II Cup before heading 
to the Arima Kinen, and takes her leave.

Feeling like she wasn't moving forward as 
resolutely as someone working hard toward 
a clear goal... Vodka set her sights on 
the Arima Kinen.
